business_review.criterion: Premium badge visible at model-selection time
business_review.note: PremiumModelBadge rendered on every premium option row in ChatPromptLlmSelector and on the selector trigger. ModelOptionLabel component shows full-name tooltip only when the name is actually truncated — avoids spurious tooltips.

business_review.criterion: Premium indication visible during active chat
business_review.note: ChatPremiumModelTip portaled above the chat prompt with a ResizeObserver anchor. Tip re-arms on chat or model change (premiumTipKey). Amber ring on the input container while premium model is active.

business_review.criterion: User can dismiss the tip and navigate to the catalog
business_review.note: Dismiss button has aria-label. Link routes to HELP_MODELS_ROUTE (/help/models). Tip re-arms on next model or chat change; dismissal is scoped per (chatId, modelValue) key.

business_review.criterion: Models catalog lists all models with premium, provider, capabilities, and cost
business_review.note: ModelsCatalogPage renders a filterable table (search, provider dropdown, premium-only checkbox). Cost formatted as per-1M-token input/output pair. Unknown providers fall back to the raw key string (graceful degradation).

business_review.criterion: Backward-compatible when is_premium absent on older backends
business_review.note: isPremium mapped with is_premium (undefined if field absent); all premium-conditional rendering uses isPremium ?? false. No UI change for non-premium models.
4941 unit tests pass. E2E harness failures are environment-related (no live LLM provider, fresh DB artifacts); none touch components introduced by this MR.

standards_review.notes: All commits follow EPMCDME-14126: Description format.
S6749 (redundant single-child fragment in ChatPrompt) and S6772 (ambiguous spacing after <input /> in ModelsCatalogPage) both fixed in the final commit.
No console.log, no commented-out code introduced.
No new API surface. Premium flag originates from the authenticated /v1/llm_models store. No user-supplied content rendered unsanitized.
Dismiss button has aria-label. Provider select has aria-label. Premium checkbox has aria-label. PremiumModelBadge tooltip uses the shared react-tooltip mechanism.
All new files (PremiumModelBadge.tsx, ChatPremiumModelTip.tsx, ModelsCatalogPage.tsx) carry the Apache-2.0 copyright header.

findings.problem: PROVIDER_LABELS maps five known provider keys. A backend deployment with an additional provider (e.g. a new cloud region) will display the raw key string in the Provider column.
findings.impact: Cosmetic — the catalog still lists the model and all data; only the provider label is less human-friendly. No user-facing breakage.
findings.recommendation: Acceptable for the initial release. If new providers are added on the backend, update PROVIDER_LABELS in the same PR as the backend change.

rationale: The implementation is clean and consistent. PremiumModelBadge is correctly composed from StatusBadge(Warning) and the tooltip constant is shared (re-used in ChatPrompt to avoid duplication). The dismissal logic is per (chatId, model) key and re-arms correctly. The ResizeObserver anchor approach is sound for the fixed-height resizable panel layout where overflow clipping would hide a sibling tip. The ModelsCatalogPage follows the existing page layout pattern (PageLayout wrapper, max-w-5xl container). All Sonar issues fixed. Only one informational finding about PROVIDER_LABELS fallback — deferred as cosmetic. No blocking issues.
